title: Best Limited-Data Integral Distinguishers for Trax
summary: The analysis establishes a maximum-data baseline for Trax, while the best limited-data integral distinguishers with the tweak included remain unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For the Trax structures, determine the best limited-data integral distinguishers obtainable with the bit-based division property when the tweak is included in the analysis. The obstacle is the combinatorial complexity of searching the very large set of possible plaintext-bit activation patterns, which increases when the tweak is incorporated; the existing analysis therefore uses the maximum possible amount of data and activates every plaintext bit except one instead of solving the limited-data optimization problem.

scope.domain: Integral cryptanalysis of the Trax structures using the bit-based division property and including the tweak in the analysis.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the best limited-data integral distinguishers obtainable with the bit-based division property for the Trax structures when the tweak is included in the analysis.

citations.label: Alzette: a 64-bit ARX-box (feat. CRAX and TRAX)

progress.summary: The source presents the limited-data search as difficult because the possible plaintext-bit activation patterns are combinatorially numerous, and says including the tweak makes this worse. The reported approach instead uses the maximum possible data and activates every plaintext bit except one.
